name: Tuna & Veg Pasta Bake
method: Heat the oven to 190C (170C fan). Cook the pasta for 10 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile soften the chopped onion, courgette and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the halved tomatoes, passata and herbs and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix the pasta, sauce and drained, flaked tuna in a baking dish. Scatter over the grated cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and bubbling, then serve hot.
